items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I played clarinet with Jack Kerri several times.

ctx.x: He played with a lot of people too. They didn't talk about it.
Yeah, he used to play with Jack Kerri. I played clarinet with Jack Kerri several times. Oh. Uh-huh.
